messages:
eli: Heads-up — noticed increased TLS handshake failures on arm64 after yesterday's base-image refresh (ubuntu:24.04 -> ubuntu:24.04-patched). Error rate spikes ~3x on canary.
maria: ugh. Any stack traces or logs?
eli: Logs show OpenSSL version bumped to 3.1.x and some callers failing with 'ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert unexpected_message'. Also a few glibc symbol lookup errors in the runtime logs for our native bindings.
sam: can you paste the failing container image tag?
eli: image: registry.redwood-inference/internal/base:2026-03-16-arm64-patch
ci-bot: [CI] Canary deployment 2026-03-16-arm64-patch -> failed healthcheck (pods 1/3 ready).
devon: rollback to previous base tag is safest short term. We should pause wider rollout.
maria: agree. Mark as P0 until we have canary stable. Can someone create the incident and add audit logging for any image pulls?
eli: created incident in #incidents — INC-2026-042. Audit: I've enabled image-pull logging for the cluster and exported to sec-audit-staging.
sam: before rollback, can we reproduce locally with a minimal repro? If it's OpenSSL ABI change, maybe a rebuild of our native bindings against the new base will fix it.
maria: rebuild will need access to KMS to sign the artifact in the private pipeline — currently the build role lacks kms:Decrypt in the private project. That's an RBAC blocker.
devon: I can grant a temporary role to the build service account. I'll add kms:Decrypt + kms:Encrypt with expiration 24h and log it.
security-bot: Note: granting kms:Decrypt requires approval for prod keys. Use a staging key or rotate later.
eli: for fast triage: two parallel tracks — A) rollback the canary to previous base: registry...:2026-03-09-arm64-stable; B) trigger a rebuild of the runtime image on ubuntu:24.04-patched with native deps recompiled.
sam: I'll start the rebuild pipeline now but it'll take ~45m. I'll also add an explicit image-sign step: `cosign sign --key k8s://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/build/cryptoKeys/cosign` — will use staging key per security-bot.
maria: keep audit trail for RBAC change and KMS grant. Devon, ping me when you add the role so I can record justification.
devon: role added to `sa-build@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com`, expires 2026-03-17T12:00Z. Logged change in infra-pt-ops.
ci-bot: [CI] Rebuild started: runtime-arm64-2026-03-16-rebuild (#7124).
eli: rolling back canary now to 2026-03-09-arm64-stable and pausing the image promotion job.
ci-bot: [Deploy] Canary rollback complete — all pods 3/3 ready.
maria: good. Keep the cluster in rollback state until rebuild passes and we run a regression suite (TLS handshake, native-binding smoke tests, perf).
sam: rebuild succeeded. Uploaded new image tag: registry.redwood-inference/internal/runtime:2026-03-16-arm64-rebuilt. Signed with staging key.
eli: deploying rebuilt image to canary now. Also added extra DEBUG logging on TLS handshake to surface errors if they still happen.
ci-bot: [Deploy] Canary deploy with rebuilt image -> pods 3/3 ready. Healthchecks green.
security-bot: CVE check: OpenSSL 3.1.x included in patched base — no new high CVEs compared to previous base; glibc changes are backports for CVE-2026-0123 (moderate). Document CVE IDs in the incident notes.
maria: follow-up action items: 1) formalize arm64 rebuild job in infra pipelines, 2) add a canary gate that runs full TLS/regression suite before promotion, 3) update runbook to include KMS RBAC checklist for temporary grants, 4) sign images and verify cosign in CI.
eli: I'll update INC-2026-042 notes with the timeline, logs, and remediation steps.
devon: will create a short PR to infra repo that auto-expire temporary KMS grants and adds an audit annotation hook.
maria: thanks team. Post-mortem to eng-security + eng-sre in 48h. :thumbsup:
sam: quick note — add multi-arch smoke tests on arm64 in nightly to catch these earlier.
eli: agreed. Closing the thread for now, monitoring metrics for 2h.
